trips = run.trip_results().to_pandas()
print(trips["outcome"].value_counts().to_string())  # what became of the trips
unfinished = trips[trips["outcome"] == "truncated"]
links = run.network.link_ids()
at = unfinished["link_at_end"].dropna().astype(int)
at.map(lambda i: links[i]).value_counts().head(5)  # the links where most unfinished cars were
